avis.titre: Dry Skin Review (Summer Face Wash Only)
avis.texte: Dry skin review: I LOVE this face wash, but only during the warmer months. I adore the scent, the feeling, and how clean I feel after using it - but as someone with chronic dry skin, I feel a bit dry after using it. It could be a lot worse, and I strongly prefer using this over anything else during summer, but I have stopped using it fall - early spring and will transition to a milk cleanser during that time. I think there is something specific in the ingredients that causes this, so this is just a warning to fellow dry skin users. It's still a personal fave!
Love this face wash sooo much. Leaves my skin feeling clean and nourished. Has a lovely smell and gives the results I need

avis.titre: Been a customer for a few years
avis.texte: I am disappointed in the change of formula , the new packaging is gorgeous but the wash is thinner and not as foaming :-(
The smell is delightful and leaves my face feeling clean and not stripped of moisture.
I love this face wash. It's the perfect balance of cleaning and brightening. The smell is amazing. It makes me feel like I am in a forest spa.

This is my go to cleanser when I feel a little extra gunky. I live in the southwest so there's always micro particulate in the air and every few days I need an extra boost to my cleanser. I don't like using it every day because like I said it's the southwest and it's inherently dry here and my aging skin doesn't need so much power daily but it's a real lifesaver about three days a week. And the smell is so lovely and brightens my mood.

I love this face wash. Simple. Soapy but doesnt dry out my skin. Smells delicious!

I've been using this face wash for years on my sensitive, dry skin and it's wonderful! After using my skin is soft and refreshed and the product smells goid

avis.titre: Still the best facewash money can buy
avis.texte: Been using this one for years, leaves my face dazzlingly clean. The new glass bottle is very chic.

This product delivers! Clean and refreshing, this cleanser firms and contours the facial skin's elasticity instantly. Look radiantly sharp walking right out of your loo or reach for the quench, drenched, Vit C Serum or Moisturizer soon after. Simply delightful! Magical for mature skin.

I've been a fan of this face wash for years. It's the only thing I've used for the better part of a decade, and I've never had anything negative to say... until now. The new pump top bottle is HORRIBLE! It's as if they didn't even test this before releasing it. After just a few weeks of use the face wash starts to seep out of the top making it sticky and causing it to constantly clog up. It also makes it impossible to get anything but a full pump out which is way more than I need causing it to run out faster. Ursa Major, please fix your pump top or go back to the previous, plastic packaging!!!

I liked this face wash, when it came in 8oz for the same price last time I purchased it. Now I seem to be paying twice as much for a glass dispenser. Sorry, just lost a customer. Let me be clear: I did not want to invest in a decorative bottle, I wanted to wash my face. Somewhere in a marketing meeting, someone apparently decided, "What if we gave them half the product, wrapped it in glass, and charged them like it's liquid gold?" And everyone just nodded. Yes, the formula is nice. No, it is not "mortgage-a-small-condo" nice. This is shrinkflation with fancy packaging cosplay. The new bottle looks great on the sink, but so would an empty wine bottle, and at least that would have come with wine first. If you're looking for a product that gently cleanses your skin while aggressively cleanses your wallet, congratulations, you've found it. As for me, I'll be over in the drugstore aisle, grieving what this used to be and buying something that doesn't require a payment plan. One star, and that's only because zero isn't an option.
Love the consistency and and how well it removes makeup or sunscreen. Really clears and smooths out the skin at the end of the day. Smells amazing. I can't imagine using anything else now.

avis.titre: Great face wash but disappointed in smell
avis.texte: This face wash does an excellent job of cleansing and the pump is very pleasant to use. I am very happy with the packaging and the consistency of the face wash. I was very excited about the smell, however I was surprised to find that the smell is actually unpleasant to me. The smell reminds me of a margarita and not in a good way. I've been using it for a couple of weeks now and I'm getting more used to the smell, but it's not the invigorating spa like smell I was expecting. I will continue to use it as it does a great job, but most likely won't repurchase due to the smell. I still love my alpine rich cream, forest alchemy eye cream, and botanic buzz hand cream which smells amazing! Will absolutely continue to buy those.

avis.titre: Price Gouging and Turning Back on Values
avis.texte: I'm a product developer with a specialization in sustainability. I remember back in the days when the products from this company were inexpensive, but still environmentally friendly, and plastic negative. Now, without changing formulas, and with the addition of aluminum and glass packaging, they have reduced many products to 50% volume and increased price significantly. They claim it's for the packaging costs, but the cost of packaging does not equal more than a 50% increase in cost with a 50% decrease in product volume. It's disappointing. The products are wonderful. They have also been deleting negative reviews.
Excellent product ! Great start to my face care routine. Love this

This face wash gives me a deep clean without feeling dried out. I like the gentle exfoliation. I gave it 4 stars because I am not a fan of the fragrance. I am more of a citrusy and fruity scent fan, so the woodsy smell is not my favorite. But it is still worth using, because my face feels so clean afterwards.

avis.titre: Product is great. Bottle is awful!
avis.texte: The fantastic face wash is a great product, but the bottle is really terrible. I have never had a product that leaked SO MUCH. You have to turn the bottle upside down to get the face wash out & after you've inverted it a few times, it just leaks. This product is too thin to be in a bottle that has a short threaded neck. By the time the bottle is half empty, the spot where it sits in my bathroom is coated in the product that has leaked out after use. Be advised, you may want to buy an alternate bottle to pour this into so your bathroom doesn't turn into a total mess.

avis.titre: 8 Years In-- Can't live without it!
avis.texte: I've been using this face wash since 2017, and I'll never look back. I struggled with problem skin my entire life—constant breakouts, inflammation, and endless visits to the dermatologist. I tried everything: creams, non-Accutane pills, Proactiv, countless products—nothing worked. I was searching for an organic solution when I discovered Ursa Major (as a Vermonter I had to give a Vermont brand a try) and it completely transformed my skin. I've been loyal ever since and can't imagine switching. Paired with their Golden Hour Recovery Cream, these two are my holy grail essentials. I'll truly be a customer for life.
